checks.why: a caller holding the interface in a constructor-injected field is a direct caller of the implementation, via the interface, resolved when it is the only one (#1542)
control: a caller that builds the concrete class keeps its plain row
with two implementations, a call through the interface is one of a set for each, worded as via the interface
near-miss control: a caller whose receiver is typed on the other implementation is not a caller of this one
the interface method itself: the call through the interface names it, resolved
